50 System-initiated (workers and queues)

Work no person starts directly: background workers on timers and SQS queue consumers.

Sign-in and access

  • X-18 Endpoints without authorization
  • X-19 Service-to-service communication
  • X-25 Redis: cache, live capacity and locks
S-01 Level capacity update (OrderSuccess queue)Apply booked/released seats to level capacity after order events. S-02 Event live capacity (EventCapacity queue)Recompute an event's live capacity after capacity changes. S-03 Locked-capacity refreshRelease seats locked by unpaid orders after they expire. S-04 Scheduler capacity reconcilePeriodic capacity reconciliation triggered from the Scheduler service. S-05 Pending/failed payment revalidationRe-check unfinished payments with DgePay and update order status. S-06 Booking status → GeneratedMark orders Generated once all their tickets exist. S-07 Initiate user ticket generationStart ticket generation for paid orders that requested it. S-08 Ticket signing via TSP (TicketSigning queue)Digitally sign ticket PDFs through the TSP and store them in S3. S-09 Reserved ticket merge/zip (TicketProcessing queue)Merge or zip a reservation's signed tickets in the Utility service. S-10 VAT challan with NBR (VatChallanProcessing queue)Record VAT for paid orders and download the challan from NBR. S-11 Push delivery to FCM (FirebaseNotification queue)Deliver queued push messages through Firebase Cloud Messaging. S-12 Ticket-generated notificationTell customers their tickets are ready. S-13 Device-token cleanupDaily removal of stale device tokens. S-14 Checked-ticket sync (Redis → database)Persist gate scans collected in Redis to the database. S-15 Gate download-status cleanupReset checker download flags on a schedule. S-16 Promo-code status updateActivate/expire promo codes by their dates. S-17 System-discount status updateActivate/expire system discounts by their dates.
